title: Sable and the Ember
author: Rafael Vane
blurb: Lena Marchetti, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
